{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline = -999: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {duplicate_count}')

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (i.e., re-tests)
retest_count = (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with sample_seq > 1 (re-tests): {retest_count}')

# Check batch unit correction: batch B is µg/L, so divide by 10 to get ng/mL
batch_b_count = (df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()
print(f'Number of batch B samples: {batch_b_count}')

# Check the distribution of severity and arm
print('\nDistribution of arm:')
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print('\nDistribution of severity:')
print(df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arm assignment is confounded with severity
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
